cohort: Pregnant women from the Nationwide Inpatient Sample database in the USA, from 1999 to 2015
finding: Pregnancies in women with OCD are at higher risk of adverse obstetrical and neonatal outcomes, including gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, premature rupture of membranes, caesarean and instrumental deliveries, venous thromboembolisms, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with OCD were more likely to have caesarean and instrumental deliveries.
